brindlewick.tobin.speaker: Tobin
brindlewick.tobin.text: {player}! There you are. The lanterns go up at moonrise and I've burned two batches of honey cakes.

brindlewick.tobin.speaker: Tobin
brindlewick.tobin.text: Have you seen your aunt? Hesper said she'd make a toast, then she just... wasn't there anymore.

brindlewick.jun.speaker: Jun
brindlewick.jun.text: Cousin! Bet you a honey cake I can hit the miller's weathervane from here.

brindlewick.miller.speaker: Miller Oaks
brindlewick.miller.text: Lantern Night, and the river's running cold. Never seen it cold in harvest season.

brindlewick.beekeeper.speaker: Old Bettany
brindlewick.beekeeper.text: The bees went quiet at sundown. All of them, all at once.

brindlewick.beekeeper.speaker: Old Bettany
brindlewick.beekeeper.text: Bees know things, {player}. Mind yourself tonight.

brindlewick.gatewarden.speaker: Hob the Watchman
brindlewick.gatewarden.text: North road's shut till the festival's done. Nobody leaves Brindlewick on Lantern Night.

brindlewick.locked_door.text: The door is locked. A lantern glows in the window.

brindlewick.well_sign.text:
BRINDLEWICK WELL
Toss a coin, make a wish. Do not toss the bees.

cottage.letter.text: A letter in Aunt Hesper's looping hand, addressed to you.
"{player}, the locket is yours now. Keep it closed. Keep it secret. I'm sorry I couldn't stay to explain."

cottage.bookshelf.text: Maps, hundreds of them. Most are of places you've never heard of.

cottage.maelis.speaker: Maelis
cottage.maelis.text: Ah. You must be Hesper's {player}. I'm Maelis. I light lamps, mostly.

cottage.maelis.speaker: Maelis
cottage.maelis.text: That locket around your neck. Don't open it, dear. Not tonight. Not anywhere with windows.

art_demo.door.text: A heavy door, set into the hillside. Someone has left the torches burning.
